answer: Because the entropy is measured at the grove gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the ledge audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. A farm emitting 57 variations of one paragraph therefore forfeits for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the jade panel. That is 2 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
